meta.name: Scrape NSR specialist data into Google Sheets with pagination and detail pages

parameters.content:
## NSR Scraper

### How it works

This workflow manually scrapes the NSR website for cardiology specialists. It establishes a session, submits the specialty search, paginates through result pages, parses doctor rows, then fetches each doctor’s detail page to extract additional information such as graduation year. Finally, it rate-limits requests and appends each enriched doctor record to Google Sheets.

### Setup steps

- Configure the HTTP Request nodes with any required headers, form fields, and cookie handling expected by nsr.org.my.
- Verify the specialty/search parameters in the submit-search request, especially the cardiology specialty value.
- Connect valid Google Sheets credentials and select the target spreadsheet, sheet, and column mapping in the append node.
- Review the code nodes’ HTML parsing assumptions against the current NSR page structure before running.

### Customization

Change the specialty ID or search form payload to scrape another specialty, adjust pagination limits if the number of result pages changes, and tune the wait duration to be more or less conservative with rate limiting.

## Start session setup

Starts the workflow manually, requests the NSR listing page, and extracts the session cookie needed for later requests.

## Submit and fetch results

Submits the cardiology search, initializes pagination at page 1, fetches the current results page, and parses table rows from the returned HTML.

## Control page pagination

Checks whether another results page exists and either loops back to fetch the next page or emits the complete collected doctor list once pagination is finished.

## Fetch doctor details

Iterates through the emitted doctors, opens each doctor detail page, and extracts the graduation year or other detail-page data.

## Rate limit and save

Pauses between processed doctors to reduce request pressure, then appends the enriched record to Google Sheets before continuing the doctor loop.
